d:
Your body can’t fully recover when your nervous system stays switched on all day. This 10 minute flow helps you slow down, release tension, breathe deeper, and finally feel your system settle before bed or after a stressful day.
We move through simple grounding shapes to open the front body, unwind the hips and spine, and shift out of constant pressure and stimulation. The way you end your day becomes the way you enter the next one. A little intentional slowing down changes more than most people realize.
